# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description

## HTML Description (for `<description>` tag in plugin.xml)

```html
<h2>Docstring Freshness Monitor — Keep Your Documentation as Fresh as Your Code</h2>

<p>Detect stale documentation automatically using git history analysis. Every docstring gets a freshness 
score (0-100) so you know which docs are trustworthy and which are outdated.</p>

<h3>Core Features</h3>
<ul>
    <li><b>Freshness Scoring</b> — 0-100 score for every docstring based on git history</li>
    <li><b>Gutter Icons</b> — Visual indicators: 🟢 Fresh, 🟡 Aging, 🔴 Stale</li>
    <li><b>Hover Tooltips</b> — Last code/doc change dates and divergent commit count</li>
    <li><b>Stale Doc Inspection</b> — IDE inspection with configurable severity</li>
    <li><b>Multi-Language</b> — Java/Kotlin, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript</li>
    <li><b>Mark as Reviewed</b> — Quick-fix to acknowledge stale docs</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pro Features ($2.90/month)</h3>
<ul>
    <li>All languages enabled simultaneously</li>
    <li>Project dashboard with treemap visualization</li>
    <li>Trend analysis tracking</li>
    <li>Export reports (HTML, JSON, CSV)</li>
    <li>CI integration with SARIF and JUnit XML output</li>
    <li>Custom score algorithm extension point</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
    <li>IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ (or any JetBrains IDE)</li>
    <li>Git repository with history</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<p>
    <a href="#">Documentation</a> |
    <a href="#">Issue Tracker</a> |
    <a href="#">Contact Support</a>
</p>
```

## Summary

**Tagline:** Keep your documentation as fresh as your code.

**Short Description (200 chars):** Detect stale documentation using git history. Freshness scores, gutter icons, stale doc inspection for Java, Kotlin, Python, JS/TS. Free core + Pro at $2.90/mo.
